Automations_ANotificationWithAStart: A notification with a Start button when a unit hasn't been washed for a while.
Automations_AUnitGoesOfflineOr: A unit goes offline or comes back
Automations_AUnitIsChangedFrom: A unit is changed from the phone app or remote
Automations_NeedsEnergyTrackingOnIn: Needs energy tracking on in airCloud Go. You are told at 80% and 100%. 0 turns it off.
Automations_OnlyUnitsKazeSwitchedOff: Only units Kaze switched off, and only if nobody turned them on in the meantime.
Automations_ShownInTheTrayMenu: Shown in the tray menu and flyout. Run one from the command line with Kaze.exe --preset "Sleep"
Automations_StartItFromTheControl: Start it from the control panel, the tray menu, the taskbar or Kaze.exe --sleep. Each step is relative to the set point when it starts. Warmer when cooling, cooler when heating.
Automations_TurnAirConditionersOffWhen: Turn air conditioners off when the PC locks
Automations_TurnAirConditionersOffWhen2: Turn air conditioners off when the PC goes to sleep
Automations_TurnThemBackOnWhen: Turn them back on when I return
Automations_UsedForTheOutdoorTemperature: Used for the outdoor temperature on the Control page and for weather conditions on schedules, such as cooling the room before you get home only on hot days. Weather comes from Open-Meteo. Only the chosen place is sent.
Automations_WaitsForTheDelaySo: Waits for the delay, so a quick Win+L doesn't switch them off.
Automations_Warn5MinutesBeforeAn: Warn 5 minutes before an off timer
Automations_WhenThePCLocksOr: When the PC locks or sleeps
Automations_WithButtonsToSnoozeIt: With buttons to snooze it for 30 minutes or cancel it.
ControlPanel_CleanTheIndoorCoilBy: Clean the indoor coil by freezing and thawing it
ControlPanel_TheUnitFreezesItsIndoor: The unit freezes its indoor coil and then thaws it to rinse off dust. It can't be controlled until the cycle ends.
Control_RoomTemperatureAndSetPoint: Room temperature and set point history
Energy_FiguresComeFromAirCloudGo: Figures come from airCloud Go and only cover units with energy tracking turned on. Results are cached for an hour to stay under the airCloud rate limits.
Login_KazeIsAnUnofficialApp: Kaze is an unofficial app and is not affiliated with Hitachi. It talks to Hitachi's airCloud Go cloud the same way the phone app does, and Hitachi may change that service at any time. Use it at your own risk.
Login_UseTheSameEmailOr: Use the same email (or phone number) and password as the airCloud Go phone app. Your password is stored encrypted in Windows Credential Manager.
Schedules_NoSchedulesYetForExample: No schedules yet. For example, turn off every weekday at 08:30, or cool to 26° at 21:00.
Schedules_SchedulesRunOnThisPC: Schedules run on this PC, so Kaze must be running and the PC awake. Occurrences missed while the PC slept are skipped.
Settings_ControlTheAirConditionerFrom: Control the air conditioner from scripts or Task Scheduler. Commands go to the running app.
Settings_DrawTheSetTemperatureOn: Draw the set temperature on the notification area icon.
Settings_KazeChecksTheGitHubRepository: Kaze checks the GitHub repository that publishes its releases and installs new versions with one click.
Settings_KazeIsAnUnofficialCommunity: Kaze is an unofficial, community built controller and is not affiliated with Hitachi. It uses the same airCloud Go cloud service as the phone app. If Hitachi changes that service, this app may stop working until it is updated. Kaze is provided as is under the MIT License, without warranty. Timers, schedules and automations run on this PC and need it to be on, awake and online, so don't rely on them where comfort or health depends on the air conditioner. Use Kaze at your own risk.
Settings_HowMuchTheWarmerAnd: How much the warmer and cooler buttons change the set point.
Settings_LetsStreamDeckPowerToysScripts: Lets Stream Deck, PowerToys, scripts or Home Assistant control your units through Kaze. Every request needs the token below.
Settings_OffMeansOnlyProgramsOn: Off means only programs on this PC can connect. On lets devices on your home network (private addresses only) connect too. The connection is not encrypted, so only turn this on for a network you trust. Windows may ask to allow Kaze through the firewall: allow it for private networks only.
Settings_StartMinimizedInTheNotification: Start minimized in the notification area when you sign in to Windows.
Settings_UsedByTheTrayIcon: Used by the tray icon, the tray menu and keyboard shortcuts.
Settings_WindowsDisplayLanguageIsUsed: Windows display language is used by default.
Settings_WorkWhileOtherAppsAre: Work while other apps are focused. Click a box and press a new combination with Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win.
